item.title: How to get the Hookshot in Ocarina of Time
item.description: Getting the Hookshot in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake is the first and most important thing you do after opening the Door of Time. The Hookshot is essential for reaching the Forest Temple and solving other mandatory puzzles, not to mention reaching harder-to-find collectibles, but the game is quite vague about where to find it. It points you to Kakariko Village, though depending on how thoroughly you investigate, you might miss some of the contextual clues entirely.

item.title: All amiibo rewards and drops in Ocarina of Time
item.description: Being a Nintendo Switch 2 game, of course, The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake has amiibo functionality . After you progress in the game, you can toggle the amiibo option in your settings, allowing you to scan in your various Zelda franchise amiibo for some rewards.

item.title: DC Studios Hit with Major Shakeup: James Gunn & Peter Safran Officially Leaving
item.description: Just four years after James Gunn and Peter Safran took control of the DC cinematic, television, and animation universe, the co-CEOs of DC Studios are stepping down. Parent company Skydance, which recently acquired Warner Bros. Discovery, announced the move on Monday, saying that Gunn and Safran will "ensure a smooth, collaborative transition" to new leadership.

item.title: Unexpected Christopher Nolan Film Officially Gets First Lego Set
item.description: Another Christopher Nolan movie is getting a Lego set, but probably not one that you’d expect. Today, the Lego Ideas Team announced that a popular fan design based on Interstellar will get an official release. The set is based on the scene when Coop (Matthew McConaughey) and Dr. Amelia Brand (Anne Hathaway) visit Miller’s planet in their Ranger spacecraft. The goofy little robot TARS also makes an appearance. Lego hasn’t confirmed its pricing, the release date, or the final build, but the set’s preliminary design is shown below.

item.title: Marvel Officially Rebooting the Hulk in 2027 With Major Power Move
item.description: Marvel is rolling out the red (or maybe green) carpet next year to kick off an all-new era for the Jade Giant. With the Infernal Hulk saga set to wrap up in 2027, Marvel Comics has revealed that Bruce Banner is getting back to basics with a new #1 from an incredible creative team. Even better, the debut will be free.

item.title: Mass Effect 3: Take Earth Back Surprises Fans With Official New Game Release
item.description: BioWare's sudden closure was heartbreaking for a number of reasons: talented developers got laid off, the studio's stumbles were preventable, and EA clearly did not understand the potential of its own franchises. For fans who adventured with Commander Shepard across three games, the biggest tragedy was a simple one. Without BioWare, there wouldn't be any new Mass Effect games . If the franchise is supposed to be dead, though, fans didn't get the memo — and Mass Effect 3 's mod Take Earth Back proves it.

item.title: Clayface Officially Passes Huge Box Office Milestone
item.description: After a strong 2025, Warner Bros. isn’t having a great 2026 at the box office. Several of the studio’s most expensive films were major bombs: Supergirl brought in only $126.4 million on an estimated $170 to $186 million budget, while Digger made just $50 million on a $125 to $180 million budget. As of late September, the studio had a paltry 6% share of the domestic market in 2026, a huge drop from its commanding 21% in 2025.

item.title: A Free GTA 6 Competitor Is Blowing Up on Steam
item.description: Grand Theft Auto 6 is just around the corner, and fans are champing at the bit as they wait for Nov. 19. Seriously, we're analyzing whether picking up dog poop and flinging it at people could change how combat may work, for crying out loud. The closer GTA 6 gets, the further away it seems.

item.title: Pokémon Go 'Into the Wild' 2026 event guide
item.description: Pokémon Go ’s 2026 "Into the Wild" event rolls into this weekend's big Wild Area flagship event, so if you need to do some Max Battles to catch up on building a good party, this is the time. Dynamax Regidrago and Dynamax Meltan will be making their debuts during this, so if you like collecting special Dynamax Pokémon, now's your chance. This event runs from Nov. 9-13 .

item.title: Ridley Scott’s Failed Dune Movie Paved the Way For His Sci-Fi Masterpiece
item.description: Denis Villeneuve’s Dune: Part 3 releases on Dec. 16, completing what has so far been a phenomenal adaptation of Frank Herbert’s seminal space opera. While David Lynch’s surreal 1984 Dune has its defenders, Villeneuve’s version has been far more commercially and critically successful. He’s made some significant deviations from the source material, but overall has proved faithful to its characters and themes while assembling an all-star cast that shines in both dramatic action sequences and smaller scenes of tense intrigue.
